context_for_next_testing_agent: All UX fixes verified for iteration 181. Key verifications: (1) ModuleSwitcher pills are fully rounded (rounded-full on nav and Links), (2) Pulse Pro manager/owner sees 8 tabs in correct order, (3) Pulse Pro staff sees 5 tabs (no Reports, Suppliers, Gym Layout), (4) Weekly Digest is inside Reports sub-menu, (5) GymFloorManagerTab has Diary on LEFT (default active) and Setup on RIGHT, (6) Topics header says 'Topics (N)' not 'Topic taxonomy', (7) Gym-floor staff can login via Pulse Portal login modal using shared credentials.
